servesNote: 2 portions — ~850 kcal / ~45 g protein each. ⭐ The most hands-on meal of the week, and a keepers-only dish: nothing in it is fresh enough to be at risk by the end of the week.
adaptations: ✅ THE TORTILLA ITSELF IS FULLY IN THE HOUSE — Tuesday bought potatoes, onions and 15 eggs, and there is a big bottle of olive oil plus 5 white wine vinegar sachets. The salad leaves and cucumber are not in; spinach and tomatoes are.

⛔ THE 100 ml OF OLIVE OIL IS THE TECHNIQUE, NOT A MISTAKE. The potatoes are POACHED in it, not fried. You drain it off afterwards and keep it, so very little is actually eaten — but going short here gives you fried potato in egg, which is a different and worse dish.

⭐ THIS IS AN OLDER CARD with four steps and few state cues. The two that matter are in it and are worth obeying literally: the potatoes must not COLOUR, and the centre should still be slightly soft when it comes out.

ingredients.prep: ⛔ yes, that much — and it gets drained off and kept
the dressing, with oil — 5 in the house

equipment.why: the poach, then wiped and hot for the set

equipment.item: A sieve or colander over a bowl
equipment.why: ⭐ draining the potatoes — KEEP the oil
folding the eggs through the warm potato, then resting 10 min

equipment.item: A plate that covers the pan
equipment.why: ⭐ this is what you flip it with

prep: Slice the potatoes thin and the onion. ⭐ Have the flipping plate out and to hand before the pan is hot — step 3 is not a moment to be going through a cupboard.

steps.text: ⭐ Potatoes and onion POACHED gently in the oil until soft but NOT COLOURED. Drain — keep the oil.
Beaten eggs, well salted, folded through the warm potato. Rest 10 min.
Back into a hot pan with a little of the reserved oil. Set the base, then FLIP WITH A PLATE and set the other side.
⭐ The centre should still be slightly soft when it comes out. Dress the salad with oil and the vinegar sachet and serve alongside.
